part.text:
Fixed. The title now renders immediately while inventory streams in.

`app/product/page.tsx` was awaiting `getInventory()` before rendering the page. I split it into a `Suspense` boundary so the static `<h1>` is sent right away and the inventory data loads asynchronously. Build passes and the product route is now using partial prerendering (`◐`).
